explanation: A prophet in the Old Testament who received revelations from God and conveyed them to the people of Israel.
God's power and presence, which works in the world and gives wisdom, understanding, counsel, strength, knowledge, and fear of the Lord.
A reference to King David's father, Jesse, symbolizing the Messiah's origin from David's royal line.
The promised Savior and King whom the Jews awaited, and whom Christians identify as Jesus Christ.
The principle of acting rightly and morally, in accordance with God's will and law.
A state of harmony and reconciliation between people and nations, as well as between people and God.
Symbols for former enemies living together in peace and harmony in the Messiah's kingdom.
The understanding of God's nature, will, and plans, which will fill the earth when the Messiah reigns.
